notable_absence.finding: None - this page follows the requiresExplicitClose obligation. See cross_component_finding.

cross_component_finding: Second confirmation in this batch that the requiresExplicitClose rule is actually followed, not just documented: the N1QL() call's returned iterator is captured into `results`, streamed with a `for...of` loop, then explicitly closed via `results.close();              // End the query and free resources held`. The page also carries the same positional-vs-named-parameter distinction as the Capella twin ('We have just one positional parameter $1 for "doc.iata"... Note positional parameters are passed in an array' / 'Note named parameters are passed and an object') and the same note that the cluster typically skips re-preparing an already-prepared statement - recurrence, not a new fact.
